summary: Engadget's Amy Skorheim rounds up the best Apple Cyber Monday deals of 2023, covering AirPods, Apple Watches, iPads, MacBooks and accessories. Even the newest products, such as the M3 MacBook Pro and Apple Watch Series 9, are discounted, and some deals hit record lows. Each entry gives the sale price, retailers, and Engadget's review verdict on whether it's worth buying.
one_line: Engadget's roundup of Cyber Monday 2023 Apple deals on AirPods, Apple Watches, iPads, MacBooks and accessories, with prices and review verdicts.
key_facts: AirPods Pro (2nd gen, USB-C) dropped to $190 at Amazon and Target, within a dollar of the recent low of $189; the Lightning version is $169 at Walmart.
AirPods Max hit a new low of $450 at Amazon and Best Buy, $30 cheaper than Prime Day in October; B&H Photo sells them for $519.
AirPods (3rd gen) with the Lightning case are $140 at Amazon and Target against a $169 list price; they lack ANC but have Adaptive EQ and are water-resistant.
Apple Watch Ultra 2 is $739 at Amazon and Best Buy, $60 off, but $9 more than its Black Friday price.
Apple Watch SE is $179 against a $249 list price; Engadget called it the best smartwatch money can buy when it came out in 2022.
Apple Watch Series 9 is $330 at Amazon, Target and Walmart, a $70 discount and a new low; its SiP chip enables the Double Tap feature.
iPad (10th generation) is $349 at Amazon, Best Buy and Target, $100 off list; the iPad Air is $499 versus a $599 MSRP and the iPad mini is back to $400 from a $499 list price.
The 9th generation iPad dropped to $229 at Amazon during Black Friday, but that deal sold out; it is $80 off MSRP at Walmart and is Engadget's best budget iPad.
The 14-inch M3 MacBook Pro is $150 off, and the M3 Pro model is $200 off at $2,199 at B&H Photo; Engadget recommends 16GB of RAM over the 8GB base model.
The 15-inch M2 MacBook Air is $1,049 at Amazon and Best Buy and scored 96 in Engadget's review; the 13-inch M2 Air is $929 at B&H Photo; the M1 Air is $750 at Amazon and Best Buy.
Buying a $100+ Apple gift card at Amazon earns $15 in Amazon credit with code APPLET5USA for the digital card, or APPLET5USAP for the physical card.
A four-pack of Apple AirTags is $80 at Amazon (19 percent off), a single AirTag is $24 at Walmart and Target, and the Apple TV 4K is $125 at B&H Photo.
The Mac mini M2 is $100 off at Amazon, B&H Photo and Best Buy, and the 512GB SSD model is $699 at B&H Photo; it scored 86 in Engadget's review.
